questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

On inquiry at the

A-that there were several through

B-railway station we were informed

C-trains to Dehradun every day
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'BAC'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the started sentence **'On inquiry at the'** we can see 'Where can you make an inquiry (in the given context)? is asking so obviously, only **the railway station **is a possible choice.** B ***'railway station we were informed'* has to be first.
 
• Hence **Option 1** is the **most appropriate** answer here.

**The correct sentence is- ***On inquiry at the railway station we were informed that there were several through trains to Dehradun every day.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

During the restoration,

P: ancient institutions were to

Q: changing but traditional society

R: be the corner stones of a
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'PRQ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the sentences **P **(ancient institutions **were to**) and **R** (be the corner stones **of a**). A sentence cannot end with '**were to' **or '**of a'**. Thus, **Q **has to be last.
 
• Hence **option 2** is the **most appropriate **answer here.

**The correct sentence is- ***During the restoration, ancient institutions were to be the corner stones of a changing but traditional society.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

One can understand the importance of faith by ______ a world without faith.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'imagining'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Using **'imagining'** in the **blank space** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The words **'Understand' **means **'something you do with your mind'.** You can't actually get a world without faith just so you can understand the importance of faith. You can just '**imagine'** it in your mind.

**The correct sentence is-** *One can understand the importance of faith by **imagining** a world without faith.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 **discovering**

 **identifying**
 *establish or indicate who or what (someone or something) is.*
 
 

 **interpreting**
 *explain the meaning of (information, words, or actions).*
